svg.title: Mauro Martinez career timeline: from running international trade operations to automating them with AI
svg.desc: 2018: International Trade Assistant at Industrias De Pascale (Aug 2018 - Feb 2021). 2021: International Trade Analyst at Coteminas Argentina (Mar 2021 - Sep 2022). Jun 2021: started in data analytics. 2022: Commercial BI Analyst at B&B Consultora (Sep 2022 - Oct 2024). 2023: Founder & AI Engineer at GlobalAIze (Sep 2023 - Present). 2024: Data Analyst for Microsoft at Launch Consulting Group (Oct 2024 - Aug 2025). Nov 2024: B.A. in International Trade, UNLaM. 2026: International Trade & AI Automation at SLS Global (May 2026 - Present).
